evals.prompt: Update our Next.js rentals map to add draggable property pins and keep the selected list card synchronized while dragging.
evals.expected_output: Uses @vis.gl/react-google-maps and AdvancedMarker, preserves stable IDs, explicit map height/mapId, and adds targeted UI tests.

evals.prompt: Add a custom place autocomplete box to the React app and fetch only name, address, and coordinates after selection.
evals.expected_output: Uses current Place Autocomplete Data API/AutocompleteSuggestion flow, session tokens, Place.fetchFields with minimal fields, and avoids legacy Places services.

evals.prompt: Review a PR that adds restaurant AI summaries from Google Places to cards. Check cost, attribution, caching, and data provenance.
evals.expected_output: Requires current official docs, minimal field masks, provider disclosure, source provenance, and does not conflate Google summaries with MDE ai_summary.

evals.prompt: Replace an old route implementation on the map and show ETA between two venues without adding deprecated Maps APIs.
evals.expected_output: Selects current Routes/Route APIs, rejects legacy directions classes, checks key restrictions and region/locale implications, and includes verification evidence.

evals.prompt: Make a generic PostGIS query that finds points inside a polygon; this project does not use Google Maps for the operation.
evals.expected_output: Maps skill should not be selected because the task is generic GIS with no Google Maps Platform dependency.
